attr.title: Ashworld
attr.desc: Survive a pixel-art wasteland, scavenge buildings, drive vehicles and fight its inhabitants.
attr.inst: Install Ashworld.zip, then copy your owned ashworld.dat into the installed ashworld folder. See ashworld.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
